name: SkeletonBlock
description: Rectangular shimmer placeholder used to hint at content shape while data is loading

props.name: circle
props.description: Renders a perfect circle using `height` as the diameter

props.name: width
props.description: Width in pixels (number) or any CSS value (string)

props.name: height
props.description: Height in pixels (number) or any CSS value (string)

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Border radius; ignored when `circle` is true
